blind.description: A stylized square stone pillar or post composed of stacked rounded masonry stones and capped with a flat square stone slab. Small patches of green moss grow along the corners and upper edges of the capstone. Surfaces are clean, solid, and stylized with hand-painted rock textures, standing directly on its stone base without an extra baseplate.
blind.from_above: A square flat stone slab with clusters of green moss decorating its corners and edges.
blind.height_vs_figure: About waist-high to the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 3 feet tall) and roughly 1.5 to 2 feet wide.
